sections.title: Steel, live
sections.intro: Classic, refined: satin chrome around spun graphite and an ice-white LCD. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Steel's layouts and colours.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Steel
sections.intro: Steel keeps Classic's gauges and puts them in chrome bezels around spun graphite dials, with a backlit ice-white LCD and its lamps set in chrome rings.

items.alt: The Steel style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Steel, drawn by the app itself

items.title: Free
items.text: Steel is free, like Classic and Graphite.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Steel's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.
